pattern: filter two periods and groups, derive two percentages
question: only Gaya Nalanda and years 2022-2023. calculate delivery coverage and postnatal coverage
gold_sql: SELECT district, year, ROUND(100.0 * institutional_deliveries / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS delivery_percent, ROUND(100.0 * postnatal_check_48h / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS postnatal_percent FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2022, 2023) ORDER BY district, year
sql_duckdb: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.district = 'Gaya Nalanda' AND T1.year = 2022 THEN T2.institutional_deliveries ELSE 0 END) AS delivery_coverage, SUM(CASE WHEN T1.district = 'Gaya Nalanda' AND T1.year = 2022 THEN T2.postnatal_check_48h ELSE 0 END) AS postnatal_coverage FROM maternal_services AS T1 INNER JOIN maternal_services AS T2 ON T1.district = T2.district WHERE T1.year = 2022 AND T2.year = 2023
